name: Finish 3D
description: Autonomously resolve, seat and verify 3D models on footprints.
description_full: Finish 3D resolves a 3D model for every footprint on a board using an offline-first chain (existing link, KiCad stock, local cache, EasyEDA/LCSC, GitHub/vendor libraries, parametric generation, placeholder), seats it with the correct rotate-then-mirror transform, and verifies the seat against the footprint courtyard with a witness self-test. Callable from the GUI, the CLI, and by other plugins / AI agents via a JSON API. Core is offline and stdlib-only.
